Rina (Optimize PM): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A  customers want clearer windows for Hosted API streaming, Console cost visuals, and Optimize recommendations. Can we get a short, non-technical timeline?
Lee (VP Product): High level for customers: Hosted streaming improvements -> late July (staged GA). Console cost visuals -> public beta mid-August, GA by end-September. Optimize recommendations -> invite-only beta September, wider beta October.
Diego (Eng): Technical callouts: hosted streaming GA depends on kernel-selection stability + two regressions fixed (padding attention and KV-cache eviction). Owners: Sanjay + Maya.
Rina (Optimize PM): Optimize gating = 30 days stable metrics + privacy review for cost comparisons. I'll circulate the data-waiver for early access.
Samira (DevEx): Docs plan: publish an "alpha" API surface now, add migration guide with examples when beta opens. SDK owners will freeze breaking changes during beta.
Nora (Sales): Private deployments need 30-45 days notice. For enterprise customers wanting early access, we need a signed addendum and legal signoff.
Lee (VP Product): Agreed. Messaging to customers should be conservative; avoid hard public dates while canaries run. Internal: we will use feature flags to decouple Console UX from underlying perf.
ops-bot: Canary window scheduled: 2026-06-28T02:00:00Z -> 2026-06-30T02:00:00Z, target 2% opt-in traffic.
Diego (Eng): Canary will include tracing + automatic rollback. If p99 > 2x baseline we abort.
Rina (Optimize PM): Action items: I will send the data-waiver and beta list.
Samira (DevEx): I'll draft the public alpha note and the migration FAQ.
Lee (VP Product): I'll confirm gating checklist and give a short customer-ready timeline by EOD Friday.
Nora (Sales): Tag me on private early-access lists.
Rina (Optimize PM): Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the beta invite template and the privacy checklist. :white_check_mark:
